text: Based on Earth-observation evidence, we cannot confirm the forest has been *completely* intact since 2020, but no significant tree-cover loss (0.5 ha or larger) occurred within the asset from 2021 to 2025. The assessment detected *no tree-cover loss events* during this period, though changes smaller than 0.5 ha or at edges might have been missed. The asset had 285.6 ha of forest in 2020 (91.77% of the area) and showed stable tree cover in prior years (322.3 ha in 2000). The evidence supports the claim of *no major deforestation* since 2020, but minor, undetected changes cannot be ruled out.
